strings.name: Ibukun Awosika
strings.role: Chair Centre founder and former First Bank of Nigeria Chair
strings.summary: Ibukun Awosika is a Nigerian entrepreneur who founded the furniture business Chair Centre and works on corporate governance and women's business leadership. She was First Bank of Nigeria's first female Chair; that tenure ended in 2021. She currently serves as Vice Chair of GSG Impact.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through 17 November 2026. Her bank chair appointment was announced in 2015 and took effect in 2016; both her bank and Cadbury directorships are treated as ended.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded a furniture business and chaired a bank, contributing to African corporate governance and women's business leadership.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Holds a chemistry bachelor's degree from the University of Ife; IESE lists her as Global Executive MBA class of 2004 and GCP class of 2013.
strings.facts.f2.label: Current public roles
strings.facts.f2.value: GSG Impact lists her as Vice Chair; she also founded a leadership academy and convenes the International Woman Leadership Conference in Dubai.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Manufacturing entrepreneurship
strings.highlights.h1.text: Developed furniture operations into office furniture and security systems businesses, also participating in the Sokoa Chair Centre joint venture.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Women's leadership and governance
strings.highlights.h2.text: Co-founded WIMBIZ and supports women's business leadership and governance through training, conferences and public discussion.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Leadership interview published
strings.timeline.t1.text: Discussed women entering leadership, understanding organizational contexts and fulfilling responsibilities.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Left the Cadbury Nigeria board
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company's notice confirmed her resignation took effect, ending a directorship that began in October 2009.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Bank chair tenure ended
strings.timeline.t3.text: Nigeria's central bank dissolved First Bank's board and appointed a successor; regulatory action is not a personal criminal conviction.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Became First Bank Chair
strings.timeline.t4.text: The bank's annual report records this as the effective appointment date, distinct from its announcement in 2015.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Joined Cadbury Nigeria's board
strings.timeline.t5.text: Her directorship began that month and later ended in May 2026.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Led the Sokoa joint venture
strings.timeline.t6.text: Appointed Managing Director and CEO of Sokoa Chair Centre, developing furniture manufacturing cooperation.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completed IESE's executive MBA program
strings.timeline.t7.text: IESE's alumni magazine lists her in the Global Executive MBA class of 2004.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Founded a furniture business
strings.timeline.t8.text: Established the business that developed into the Chair Centre Group, entering the office furniture industry.
